description_excerpt: Purpose of the Role Own tooling for Altra footwear from confirmation through mold opening and commercialization. This is a Altra Sourcing position dedicated to Altra. The role sits within Altra Sourcing as the brand’s dedicated Sourcing tooling owner, responsible for confirming tooling, proposing red line changes, managing midsole and outsole vendor relationships, and driving mold openings and timelines. The Tooling Manager, on behalf of Altra Sourcing, makes and owns tooling decisions for Altra programs, making sure tooling reflects Altra’s design intent, is manufacturable, and is ready on…
